requirements.evidence: Contract met: CallMode enum with the three string cases (app/Enums/CallMode.php:7-9), NoWaitingTicketsException extends RuntimeException (app/Exceptions/NoWaitingTicketsException.php:7), invokable no-arg action with the exact signature (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:16-20). Queue row locked and is_active read from DB inside the transaction (:24-31); fairness looks at last 3 called by called_at desc, id desc, needs all priority and a waiting normal (:39-61); mode filters and ordering (:68-80); candidate re-locked and re-checked, skipped if not waiting (:84-92); only status/called_at/called_by_user_id set and the saved model returned (:94-99); NoWaitingTicketsException when nothing eligible (:102). Small risk: fairness history filters on status = Called (:42) instead of 'has been called' (e.g. called_at not null), so it silently breaks once tickets move past 'called' (served/skipped) in later work.

conventions.evidence: Domain write lives in app/Actions as required and docs/business-rules.md and docs/architecture.md are updated. But the change ships no Pest test at all, against 'No production code without a test; everything implemented ships with a test', and CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] is not updated. No PHPDoc on the new public __invoke.

security.evidence: Authorization is explicitly out of scope (caller trusted). No mass assignment: attributes are set one by one (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:94-96). Concurrency handled with lockForUpdate on the queue and the candidate rows (:24-27, :85-88). No user input or output rendering involved.

tests.evidence: The diff has no test files. Nothing covers ordering, the three modes, the fairness streak and reset, the inactive-queue rejection, NoWaitingTicketsException, other-queue isolation or the skip-if-already-called path.

simplicity.evidence: Single action and no extra layers. Minor redundancy: the NormalOnly and restrictToNormal branches repeat `where('priority', 0)` (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:70-74) and the ordering branch repeats the same condition (:76). Plucking all candidate ids (:82) is simple but loads every waiting id.

readability.evidence: Clear names ($lockedQueue, $restrictToNormal, $candidateIds) and helpful comments (:22-23, :35-36). However the whole algorithm sits in one ~85-line closure; extracting fairness and candidate-query helpers would make it easier to read.

scope.evidence: Only the action, enum, exception and the two docs required by task rule 9 are changed. The removed architecture TODO and the business-rules scope note are directly superseded by this feature.

issues.explanation: There are no Pest tests for a concurrency- and ordering-sensitive domain action, which breaks the project's mandatory test-first rule and leaves the fairness, mode, inactive-queue and exactly-once rules unverified.

The fairness history selects tickets with status = Called rather than tickets that have been called (called_at not null), so once tickets leave the 'called' status the streak calculation will be wrong.
The conventions require a CHANGELOG entry under [Unreleased] for changes; none was added.
The new public __invoke has no PHPDoc describing the thrown InactiveQueueException and NoWaitingTicketsException, although the docs-sync convention asks for it.
The NormalOnly and restrictToNormal branches repeat the same filter and ordering; they could be folded into one $normalOnly boolean.

review.summary: The change implements CallNextTicket, CallMode and NoWaitingTicketsException correctly by reading: queue and candidate locking, inactive-queue rejection, mode filters, deterministic ordering, the fairness rule and the write-once update all match the task, and the docs are updated. It ships no tests at all, though, which breaks the project's mandatory TDD convention for logic that is critical for concurrency and fairness, and it also leaves out the CHANGELOG entry, so it needs changes before it can merge.
